confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on 2026 aggregator guides and venue menus (Time Out, Expatistan, Citiesinsider, Boothby, eatdrinkcheap), not an official price index; beer, wine and cocktail figures vary by venue type and suburb. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the comparable-city basis, not from live listings, so they are low confidence. FX: the 0.7021 USD_PER_AUD value for 2026-10-27 was taken from a third-party mirror (allratestoday.com) that reports the RBA rate. I did not open rba.gov.au, so the official RBA F11 series should be checked before use. The latest RBA observation for 2026-11-19 was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Melbourne is priced from its own 2026 food and drink sources, cross-checked against Sydney, which sources describe as broadly comparable on restaurant meals and somewhat pricier on pub meals. Accommodation is benchmarked against mid-sized Australian capital hotel and hostel levels, with no live price checks.
